rules.name: SendKeys Usage
rules.recommendation: SendKeys can be exploited for code injection. Avoid using SendKeys.

rules.name: Shell Command Execution
rules.recommendation: Shell() executes system commands. Ensure input is validated.

rules.name: WScript.Shell Creation
rules.recommendation: Creating WScript.Shell allows command execution. Use with caution.

rules.name: Dynamic Code Execution (VBA)
rules.recommendation: Application.Run can execute arbitrary code. Validate input.

rules.name: Excessive Error Suppression
rules.recommendation: Multiple 'On Error Resume Next' found. This can hide bugs.
